_comment: Brisket League Fair Value challenger, v1 (SHADOW ONLY). Read by
src/league_valuation/ and nothing else; no route, contract field, cache,
PROVENANCE OF EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE: every constant is a PRIOR - a
starting value chosen for a stated reason, NEVER fitted on the current
board (fitting the shrinkage on the board it shrinks would be circular).
A later version may fit k only inside chronological evaluation folds
against held-out outcomes, under a new preregistration.
There is deliberately NO centring constant here: the population's
level is preserved structurally (quantile matching permutes observed
in-population canonical values), so no reference value decides the
paramSetId is the content hash of everything except itself
file whose id does not match its content.

kMax.why: A strong market prior: the best-evidenced row moves at most a quarter of the log distance toward its matched value. Unvalidated; not fitted.

quality.why: Evidence quality from the UTILITY evidence only (real projection families behind the BDVM record). It never reads the market row's confidence, so a low-confidence or policy-discounted market row is never amplified.

freshness.why: BDVM projection snapshots refresh weekly (dynasty-bdvm-refresh, Tue). Seven days of cadence plus three days of grace; an unknown snapshot date is missing freshness, not fresh.

idpFanOut.why: The per-player IDP component is admitted only when the utility-vs-market disagreement is stable across pool depth - scoring_fit's depth fan-out test, reused read-only (DEPTH_PROBES, MAX_DEPTH_DRIFT, MIN_COHORT_SIZE). Failing it forces k = 0 for the whole IDP scope.
